name: How quickly do I need to address water damage to prevent mold?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to address water damage to prevent mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can begin to grow within 24 to 48 hours after water damage occurs if moisture is not properly addressed. It is crucial to start the drying and remediation process as soon as possible. Professional restoration services use specialized equipment to extract water, dry affected areas, and monitor humidity levels to prevent mold formation. Delays in addressing water damage significantly increase the risk of mold growth, leading to more extensive and costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address water damage within 24-48 hours to prevent mold growth. Professional restoration helps ensure thorough drying.
